name: Is That a Chicken?
summary: Is That a Chicken? is a first-person VR sandbox game set on a space farm. Players collect mutant chickens, experiment with different tools and actions to discover new types, and complete the Chicken-dex. Eggs can be gathered, cooked, and served to alien customers to earn gold. The game combines creature collection, shop management, and physical interactions with chickens and objects.
